title: docs(skills): teach the seed modes the loader runs (ignore default, replace deletes nothing) and that a deleted seed row stays deleted
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"huangyiirene"} -->
_Requested by **Irene** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TJXtQ1tVD26ecLDZxFS67x?thread=cmsg_01TJXtQ1tVD26ecLDZxFS67xTkTkeVm9Y984jksBytJ867)_

Fixes #31090

Item 3 of the card (the seed `mode` text in `packages/spec/src/data/seed.zod.ts`, comment 6702892720) is routed to the spec lane as #31099 (with the stale `replace` string in `packages/cli/src/commands/diff.ts:81`). This PR does not touch `packages/spec`; the wording owed is listed below.

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

`dispatch-gates --tier` reads a MANDATORY model tier for `skills/**` (clause ① of the model-tiering ruling); it is waived by the standing order of the maintainer in this project (2026-11-03), and this card ran on the project's default model. The dispatching seat runs the contract review.

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：`objectstack-data` 技能的 `references/seeds.md` 改正种子模式：默认是 `ignore`（只建不改），`replace` 不删任何行，`insert` 每次重放都会重复插入；并补一句「AppPlugin 的启动和按组织重放不会把人删掉的种子行插回（发布、装包不记账，会插回），`seed-replayer` 带 `{ reseed: true }` 才恢复」。`content/docs/data-modeling/seed-data.mdx` 新增一小节讲同一规则，并列出不记账的加载入口。
- 为什么改：技能表格仍写 `upsert`（默认）和 `replace` =「先删光再插」，自 #30081 起已不成立；PR #31083 落地的「已落地键」规则文档里没有，客户想找回示例数据没有文档可查。
- 风险与回滚：只改文字和一条评测的期望描述；`seeds.md` token 1566 → 1560（上限不动）；发 `@objectstack/skills` patch；回滚即 revert。
- 先看：`skills/objectstack-data/references/seeds.md` 的「Import modes」表及其下一段，`seed-data.mdx` 新小节「A Deleted Seed Row Stays Deleted」，对照下文「Code sites」。
- 两分钟验证：`node scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs`，预期退出 0，`skills/objectstack-data/references/seeds.md is 1560 tokens (ceiling 1566; headroom 6)`。
- 需要你做的：`skills/**` 属 Tier H（人合），需要 `os-zhuang` 或 `hotlong` 的一次 approval，之后席位落地。

## What changes

**`skills/objectstack-data/references/seeds.md`** (whole-file sweep):

```diff
-| `externalId` | `'name'` | Stable business key used for upsert / update lookup |
-| `mode` | `'upsert'` | Import strategy (see below) |
+| `externalId` | `'name'` | Stable business key every keyed mode matches on |
+| `mode` | `'ignore'` | Import strategy (see below) |
@@ Import modes
-| `upsert` (default) | Update by `externalId`, insert if missing. Idempotent. | Reference data, bootstrap rows |
-| `insert` | Insert all; fail on duplicate `externalId`. | Append-only / audit tables |
+| `ignore` (default) | Create-only: insert a missing row, leave a matched row as is. | Data the customer owns |
+| `upsert` | Insert if missing; every replay writes declared columns back. | Reference data kept current |
+| `insert` | Insert every record, no match: duplicates on each replay. | Rows loaded once |
 | `update` | Update only existing rows; never create. | Patching existing config |
-| `ignore` | Insert; silently skip duplicates. | Additive bootstrap |
-| `replace` ⚠️ | Delete everything, then insert. **Data loss.** | Cache / lookup tables only — never user data |
+| `replace` ⚠️ | Insert with no match; deletes nothing, the caller clears the table. | Cache / lookup tables only |
+
+A seed replays on each boot, install and re-publish. AppPlugin's boot and organization
+replays (not a publish or package install) do not re-insert a keyed row a
+person deleted; `seed-replayer` with `{ reseed: true }` restores it.
@@ Seed best practices
-| Default to `upsert` | Idempotent re-runs |
+| Leave `mode` unset; `upsert` only for reference data | Replays keep customer edits |
-| Use `replace` only on cache/lookup tables, with comments | Data-loss footgun |
+| `replace` only on cache tables the caller clears | It never deletes: duplicates otherwise |
```

Also in that file:
- Quick start: the demo `categorySeed` (≈L36) drops `mode: 'upsert'`, so demo data takes the create-only default (as `seed-data.mdx` teaches). The reference `statusSeed` (≈L26) keeps `mode: 'upsert'`: reference data is the case `upsert` is for.
- `applyOn` section: its example `defineSeed(Invoice, …)` gains `mode: 'upsert'`. Without it the example ran under `ignore`, where `applyOn: 'create'` changes nothing, so it silently relied on the old default.

**`skills/objectstack-data/evals/hooks-security-seeds-datasources.json`**, case 4. The demo `Opportunity` seed had no `mode`, yet the case required `applyOn: 'create'` to keep a replay off `stage`, which only matters under the old `upsert` default. The prompt now asks for demo rows refreshed from the seed on every replay except `stage`, so the right answer is `mode: 'upsert'` plus `columns: { stage: { applyOn: 'create' } }`, and `expected_output` says so. The assertions are unchanged and every one of them is now live (review S3: the dataset declares `upsert`, rather than dropping the `must_contain`).

**`content/docs/data-modeling/seed-data.mdx`**: a new subsection, "A Deleted Seed Row Stays Deleted", after the `insert` subsection: the landed-keys rule; the loads that keep and honour it (AppPlugin's single-tenant boot seed, per-organization replay and dev hot reload, for a known organization); the loads that keep no record, where a deleted row comes back (a seed publish, a package install or upgrade including the marketplace install, heal and sample-data reseed, a load with no organization, a composition without `sys_seed_landed_key`, the marketplace's fallback `seed-replayer`); the once-more case for a row deleted before the upgrade; and the `seed-replayer` `{ reseed: true }` door. The `ignore` and `upsert` rows of the modes table link to it, scoped to "a boot or organization replay". The rest of the page (`:74-80`) already matched the loader.

Plus `.changeset/skills-data-seed-modes-landed-keys.md`: `'@objectstack/skills': patch`.

## Why

An AI that follows the published skill writes seeds expecting `upsert` replays by default and a `replace` that clears the table. Neither is what the loader does since #30081. After #31021 (PR #31083), a seed row a person deleted stays deleted across replays, and nothing documented that or how to restore it.

## Code sites (each taught fact, measured on `main` b6315733)

| Taught fact | Code site |
|---|---|
| The default `mode` is `ignore`, and the loader's `defaultMode` is that same default | `packages/spec/src/data/seed.zod.ts:193` `mode: SeedMode.default('ignore')`; `packages/spec/src/data/seed-loader.zod.ts:253`; `packages/metadata-protocol/src/seed-loader.ts:1303` `dataset.mode \|\| config.defaultMode` |
| `ignore`: matched row skipped, missing row inserted | `packages/metadata-protocol/src/seed-loader.ts:3298-3304` (`writeRecord`), `:3355-3356` (`decideWriteAction`) |
| `upsert`: matched row updated with the declared columns (skipped only on a no-op), missing row inserted | `seed-loader.ts:3284-3296`, `:3350-3354` |
| `insert`: inserts every record, no match | `seed-loader.ts:3267-3270`, `:3357-3360` |
| `update`: matched row updated, missing row skipped | `seed-loader.ts:3272-3282`, `:3345-3349` |
| `replace` deletes nothing: it inserts, "caller should have cleared the table" | `seed-loader.ts:3306-3310`, `:3358-3360`; no `'replace'` branch anywhere in `packages/metadata-protocol/src` or `packages/runtime/src` clears a table |
| The record of landed keys is the organization-owned `sys_seed_landed_key` (cascades with the organization) | `packages/platform-objects/src/system/sys-seed-landed-key.object.ts:47`, `:88` |
| Only `upsert` / `ignore` datasets read and write it | `seed-loader.ts:1406-1408` |
| A recorded key whose row is gone is not inserted again; a never-recorded key still lands | `seed-loader.ts:1946-1951` `isWithdrawnRow`; option doc `:671-690` |
| A reference to the removed row is left unwritten, not reported unresolved | `seed-loader.ts:2701` (`resolveReferenceItem` answers `withdrawn` via `isWithdrawnSeedTarget`, `:4119-4122`), handled at `:2066` and `:2851` |
| Loads that honour it: boot seed, per-organization replay, dev hot reload | `packages/runtime/src/app-plugin.ts:2098` (boot), `:1996` (replayer), `:2526` (hot reload), all through `seedLoaderOptionsFor` `:84-98` |
| The boot seed is single-tenant; a multi-tenant boot skips it for the per-organization replay | `app-plugin.ts:2069` (`organizationWallActive`), `:2084` (`multi-tenant mode — skipping inline seed`) |
| Loads that keep no record (no `landedKeys` option) | `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-publish-batch.ts:103` (publish apply); `packages/runtime/src/domains/packages.ts:4729` (package install); `packages/cloud-connection/src/marketplace-install-local-plugin.ts:2982`, `:4768`, `:4880` (install-local loads); its fallback `seed-replayer` `:1689` (`registerSeedReplayerIntoKernel`, only when none is registered) |
| No organization or no `sys_seed_landed_key`: no record, said once | `seed-loader.ts:4051-4070` |
| The deliberate re-seed: kernel service `seed-replayer`, `(organizationId, { reseed: true })` | `app-plugin.ts:1963` (signature), `:1996` (`reseed === true` → `'reseed'`), `:2042` → `packages/runtime/src/seed-datasets.ts:41` service name; callable by server code holding a plugin context (`ctx.getService`), e.g. `packages/plugins/organizations/src/organizations-plugin.ts:408`; it has no HTTP route |
| A row deleted before this release comes back once, then is remembered | PR #31083 body, "Boundaries, by design"; the first load records every row still present (`seed-loader.ts:2491` `recordLandedKeys`) |

## Acceptance notes

### Token budget (`node scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs`, exit 0)

| File | `main` | head | Ceiling |
|---|---|---|---|
| `skills/objectstack-data/references/seeds.md` | 1566 | 1560 | 1566 (unchanged) |
| `skills/objectstack-data/SKILL.md` | 6078 | 6078 (not touched) | 6078 |
| `skills/objectstack-data/evals/hooks-security-seeds-datasources.json` | 1753 | 1786, measured, not ratcheted (eval fixture) | — |

No ceiling moves; the ratchet script is not touched. Every added line in `seeds.md` is at most 120 bytes (longest: the `replace` row, 119 B; `ignore` row 111 B, `upsert` row 106 B). The corrected rows plus the landed-keys lines were paid by deleting restatement in the same file:

| Deleted | Surviving home |
|---|---|
| Intro: "`defineSeed()` is type-safe: TypeScript checks every record's field keys against the object definition." | Same file, Seed best practices row "Always use `defineSeed()`, never `SeedSchema.parse()` — Lose compile-time field checking otherwise" |
| `applyOn` intro: "A seed is replayed (every dev-server boot, every re-publish)" | Same file, the line under the modes table: "A seed replays on each boot, install and re-publish." |
| `applyOn` intro: "right for master data," | The modes table, `upsert` row: "Reference data kept current" |
| `applyOn` parenthesis: the mode-by-mode restatement, shortened to "`update` never writes it; no other mode updates a matched row" | The modes table rows for `ignore` / `insert` / `replace` |
| Determinism gate: "CEL + pinned `now` is what guarantees that — using `Date.now()` will fail CI." | Same file, Dynamic values (CEL): "This is the only correct way … `new Date()` ships the package author's clock to every customer and breaks build determinism." |
| Quick start `categorySeed`: `mode: 'upsert',` | Not restatement: removed as a correction (demo data takes the default). |

### Review fixes (contract review 6703924081)

- M1: `seed-data.mdx` names the loads that keep no record, so a deleted row comes back on a publish or a package install or upgrade, and says the boot seed is the single-tenant boot. The `ignore` row's "(unless a person deleted it)" now reads "(a boot or organization replay skips one a person deleted)".
- S1: the mdx names the marketplace fallback `seed-replayer`, a load with no organization, and a composition without `sys_seed_landed_key`. `seeds.md` scopes its sentence to "AppPlugin's boot and organization replays (not a publish or package install)".
- S2: `seeds.md` says again when a seed replays: "each boot, install and re-publish".
- S3: eval case 4's demo dataset now declares `upsert` (prompt and `expected_output`); the `must_contain` list is unchanged and live.
- S4: done by the seat (#31099); the body links it.
- S5: the `ignore` and `upsert` rows are 111 B and 106 B.
- N1: the mdx `upsert` row links the rule too. N2: the `externalId` row says "every keyed mode matches on".

### Sweep hits

Grep for `upsert (default)`, `default.*upsert` and `replace.*delete` (plus the seed `mode` claims by hand) over `skills/objectstack-data/SKILL.md`, `rules/*.md`, `evals/*.json` and `references/`:

- `references/seeds.md:51` (`externalId` "upsert / update lookup", N2), `:52` (`mode` default), `:63` (`upsert` (default)), `:64` (`insert` "fail on duplicate"), `:66` (`ignore` "silently skip duplicates"), `:67` (`replace` "Delete everything"), `:160` ("Default to `upsert`"), `:163` (`replace` "Data-loss footgun"): fixed.
- `references/seeds.md:36` (demo seed `mode: 'upsert'`) and `:82-86` (`applyOn` example without `mode`): fixed, as above. `:26` (reference data `mode: 'upsert'`): correct, left.
- `evals/hooks-security-seeds-datasources.json` case 4: implicit old default (it required `applyOn: 'create'` on a dataset with no `mode`), fixed as above.
- `SKILL.md`, `rules/*.md`, `evals/objects-fields-relationships.json`: no hit. (`SKILL.md:104` "derived verbs (search/export/upsert/…)" is the API verb, not a seed mode.)

Other `content/docs` pages that restate seed modes: the generated reference pages (`references/data/seed.mdx:33`, `references/data/seed-loader.mdx:198`, `references/api/package-api.mdx:246`, `references/kernel/manifest.mdx:100`) already say `ignore` is the default and `replace` inserts into a table the caller cleared; they pick up the spec wording below when it lands. No hand-written page outside `seed-data.mdx` restates them wrongly. Releases pages were not read for edits (release-owned).

Outside both lanes, found while measuring: `packages/cli/src/commands/diff.ts:81` still says `replace` means "a replay deletes every row of the object and inserts these". It is CLI output text, carried on #31099; not touched here.

### Spec wording owed (spec lane, item 3, filed as #31099; not edited here)

`packages/spec/src/data/seed.zod.ts`:

- `:27` enum comment `'replace',   // Delete ALL records in object then insert (Dangerous - use for cache tables)` → e.g. `// Insert with no match; the loader deletes nothing, the caller clears the table (cache tables)`.
- `:24` enum comment `'insert',    // Try to insert, fail on duplicate` → e.g. `// Insert every record with no match: a replay duplicates rows unless a unique index refuses them`.
- `:171-172` docstring "a load inserts the records whose row is missing" and `:195-196` `.describe()` "a missing row is inserted and an existing row is left as it is" → add: a missing row whose key already landed in the organization (a person removed it) is not inserted again by AppPlugin's loads (boot, per-organization replay, dev hot reload); the `seed-replayer` service with `{ reseed: true }` inserts it.
- `:116-117` the strict-object `history` string "on the defaults (`mode: upsert`, …)" describes the default at the time; accurate as history, optional to annotate.

## Tests

None: the diff is teaching text and one eval expectation, with no runtime behaviour to test. The gates below are the checks.
